en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Asbat who said,

‘He (9<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) came out to me, so I looked at his<sup>asws</sup> head and his<sup>asws</sup> feet in order (to be able to) describe his<sup>asws</sup> stature to our companions in Egypt. So while I was like that until he<sup>asws</sup> sat and said: ‘O Ali! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Argued regarding the Imamate with the like of what He<sup>azwj</sup> Argued regarding the Prophet-hood, so He<sup>azwj</sup> Said
[19:12] and We Granted him the Wisdom whilst he was a child [12:22] And when he reached his maturity [46:15] until when he attains his maturity and reaches forty years.
Thus, it is allowed that He<sup>azwj</sup> Grants the Wisdom while he<sup>as</sup> is a child, and it is allowed that He<sup>azwj</sup> Grants it while he<sup>as</sup> is forty years old’.
